paths.name: the Forge
paths.flavour: Your soul learned its shape at the anvil. Heat and metal answer you a little more readily.

paths.name: the Blade
paths.flavour: Every fight you walked away from left something behind. It sharpened rather than scarred.

paths.name: the Harvest
paths.flavour: Seasons of soil and patience settled into you like good loam.

paths.name: the Warden
paths.flavour: You have spent more of yourself standing between danger and other people than fighting for yourself.

paths.name: the Tide
paths.flavour: Something in you moves the way water does: patient, persistent, never quite still.

paths.name: the Hunt
paths.flavour: Tracking, patience and the killing blow have worn a groove into your soul.

paths.name: the Healer's Hand
paths.flavour: Hands that have closed a hundred wounds stop being ordinary hands.

paths.name: the Scholar
paths.flavour: You learned to see the shape of things before touching them.

paths.name: the Merchant's Weight
paths.flavour: People trust your word a little more than they can explain, and your coin a little less easily counterfeited.

paths.name: the Wanderer
paths.flavour: No one thing claimed you. The road itself did.
